notes: Assassination at 60, hand-curated from simmed candidates (design/reviews/2026-10-07-rogue-curation.md) and re-searched at the raid build (design/reviews/2026-10-07-raid-builds.md). Mutilate builds, and combo points are spent from three: Cold Blood and Eviscerate, with Slice and Dice ahead of it whenever it has lapsed. With Blood Splatter, Rupture goes up at four whenever Slice and Dice is running and Rupture is not. Venom was a finisher the rotation did not cast; since client 1.60.1.70755 it is a passive on Shank (poisons 30% harder and 20% more likely for 6 seconds), so the Shank line carries it. Without the Mutilate talent the Mutilate line falls through to Sinister Strike. Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst. 2026-11-02 guide rewrite: Stealth and Garrote on the pull, +0.55% raid 60 (Ambush -0.1%). Client 1.60.1.70755: Shank (1329283 at 24, 1329549 at 44; off-hand 50% weapon damage, 5 energy for +15/+25, 10 sec cooldown, cannot miss) is new for every rogue and is cast on cooldown right after the cooldowns line.

expected_idle.reason: Sinister Strike is the builder only for a rogue without Mutilate (its line is gated on Mutilate being unknown); from the rung where the talent is taken, Mutilate builds every combo point and Sinister Strike is idle by design.

Slice and Dice sits ahead of Eviscerate at four or more combo points, and below level 40 its short ranks lapse often enough to take every such set, so Eviscerate goes uncast on the ladder's low rungs; from level 40 on, with the talents and gear of the later rungs, Eviscerate fires. The ladder DPS at levels 10 to 38 is unchanged by the order.

engineering_notes.5: sim/rogue/mutilate.go: an untalented rogue has no Mutilate spell registered.
engineering_notes.3: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.

Forever Sixty default rotation, unvalidated until the nightly job runs

priorityList.notes: Shank on cooldown: it cannot miss, pays back more energy than it costs and, with Venom, makes your poisons hit 30% harder and land more often for 6 seconds.
Slice and Dice at four or more combo points when it is down or has under 3 seconds left.
Rupture at four or more combo points while Slice and Dice is up and Rupture is not ticking, only with Blood Splatter (the raid build): it lasts 6 seconds longer, and bleeds always crit in Forever.
Cold Blood at four or more combo points, right before the Eviscerate. It is off the global cooldown and costs nothing, so it waits for the finisher.
Eviscerate at four or more combo points. Mutilate gives two points a cast and three on a Seal Fate crit, so waiting for exactly five wastes a Mutilate.
Mutilate is the builder: both daggers strike, two combo points a cast, harder against a poisoned target.
Sinister Strike only before you have Mutilate.
